nina: Opened a small PR to clarify embed-sharded variants in the catalog and add a tiny client snippet + bench note. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/678

kevin: Nice. Which models return multi-vector outputs? Add a one-line table 'models -> shards' so SDKs can handle it.

nina: Added table: nebula3b: 2 shards, aurora-lite: 3 shards (experimental). Also noted sequence_limit: 4096 for these entries.

ara: Can you show how a client can detect shard outputs and recombine? Keep it minimal.

nina: Added snippet in the PR:
```
# python
from redwood import Client
c = Client()
r = c.embed("short text", model="nebula3b:embed-sharded")
vec = r.data[0]
if isinstance(vec[0], list):
    # multi-shard -> concat
    full = []
    for shard in vec:
        full.extend(shard)
    print("combined length", len(full))
else:
    print("single vector length", len(vec))
```

kevin: Please attach raw run logs for the med/p95 numbers you added. Also add a one-line Dedicated note: verify pool labels for shard placement.

nina: Gist with logs: https://gist.github.com/nina/embed-shard-678. Bench note added: single-vector med 36ms p95 82ms; sharded (2x) med 64ms p95 145ms. Dedicated migration tip added.
